body:
As millions of people build with Lovable, more of them are using it to run and grow their businesses—from tools that help them manage their operations to the software their whole company runs on, increasingly with AI automating core processes. The more complex that software becomes, the more the platform has to support: AI agents that reliably carry out business tasks, and infrastructure that scales with the applications built on it.

That's why we're excited to announce that Lovable has acquired the team behind Radish AI. They built an agentic infrastructure platform designed to make building, deploying, and scaling complex AI agents fast and reliable, with privacy and security built in. Radish AI did for AI agents what Lovable does for software: made something hard feel simple.

The Radish AI team has led AI and engineering work on systems used by billions of people at some of the world's largest tech and financial companies. They're now joining Lovable's engineering team:

• Nirman Gupta , a former engineering leader at Meta, has more than a decade of experience building large-scale systems at Meta, Bloomberg, and in financial services.

• Ish Singh , a two-time founder, previously led AI, machine learning, and data products, as well as AI transformation initiatives, at Google, JPMorgan, and Goldman Sachs.

• Adrian Zgorzałek spent 12 years at Meta leading developer experience and infrastructure efforts across social graph distributed systems, privacy infrastructure, and GraphQL.

Their experience will shape the agent capabilities and infrastructure behind Lovable, helping businesses automate their operations, run reliably, and grow—all on software they build themselves.

The team will be split between our Stockholm and London offices, with Nirman leading engineering on agents for businesses from Lovable's newly opened London office , further establishing the city as our second engineering, product, and design hub after Stockholm.

We're continuing to grow our engineering team. Explore our open roles at lovable.dev/careers .
ar_body:
أعلنت Lovable استحواذها على الفريق الذي يقف خلف Radish AI، وهي منصة بنية تحتية للوكلاء الذكيين صُممت لجعل بناء ونشر وتوسيع وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي المعقدين سريعًا وموثوقًا، مع خصوصية وأمان مدمجين.

يأتي ذلك مع تزايد استخدام الشركات لـ Lovable في تشغيل أعمالها وتنميتها، ما يتطلب وكلاء ينفذون المهام التجارية بموثوقية وبنية تحتية تتوسع مع التطبيقات.

• Nirman Gupta: قائد هندسي سابق في Meta، بخبرة تفوق عقدًا في الأنظمة واسعة النطاق في Meta وBloomberg والقطاع المالي.
• Ish Singh: مؤسس سابق قاد منتجات الذكاء الاصطناعي والبيانات في Google وJPMorgan وGoldman Sachs.
• Adrian Zgorzałek: قضى 12 عامًا في Meta في البنية التحتية وتجربة المطورين.
• سيتوزع الفريق بين مكتبي ستوكهولم ولندن، وسيقود Nirman هندسة الوكلاء للشركات من مكتب لندن الجديد.

تعزز الصفقة قدرة Lovable على أتمتة عمليات الشركات عبر برمجيات يبنونها بأنفسهم.
